summary: Helio Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing a binding settlement agreement with Sean Wolf to resolve $879,163 in outstanding promissory note obligations. The settlement will be satisfied through a structured 'leak-out' share sale plan, with Wolf selling Helio common stock subject to volume-based limits (e.g., up to 4,000 shares on days with ≥20,000 shares traded, or 12% of daily volume). The company agreed to remove restrictive legends on 225,000 shares and facilitate a Rule 144 opinion for 275,000 shares held by Pitman. This is a debt-for-equity conversion via structured trading, not a traditional special situation. Watch for potential dilution impact on Helio's stock.
